description: Compute the running order and timing of a presentation variant: each slide's start time and duration in TALK order (variant slide_order if set, else slide positions), the total, and a warning if the total exceeds target_duration_sec. Duration per slide comes from the note's seconds, or is estimated from the speaker text (words ÷ wpm + buffer) when not set. Required: presentation_id and either variant_id or language. Optional: wpm (default 130).

wpm.description: Speaking rate in words per minute for estimates (default 130)

name: get_schedule
